elena: Customer (ACME) reports structured output failing in json_mode="strict" — numeric IDs are coming back quoted and a few boolean flags are null/omitted. They hit a hard parse error in their pipeline.

mike_support: Can you paste the request + response (sanitized) and a request_id? Also which model/version?

elena: repro curl below (sensitive bits redacted). Response shows id as "12345" (string) instead of number and enabled is null instead of false.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-rlhf-v2",
    "json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"enabled":{"type":["boolean","null"]}}},
    "json_mode": "strict",
    "input": "give me an object with id (integer) and enabled (boolean)."
  }'
```

Response (truncated):
```
{"output": {"id":"12345","enabled": null}}
```

jordan_ml: Hmm — this looks like the model is emitting quoted numerics intermittently. We've seen this when the prompt or examples include quoted IDs or when the model was recently updated and the tokenizer/formatting nudges it toward strings. Also enums/case can flip if examples show different casing.

qa_tester: Repro is flaky — 3/10 runs return id as number, 7/10 as string. No obvious client-side wrapper. Started after model roll on 2026-02-10.

eng-oncall: Please add the request_id and last 5s of the serving logs. Any latency or retries seen? We need the trace to correlate.

elena: request_id=rc-20260210-9a7b, model=redwood-rlhf-v2, observed p99 latency ~2s on the failing one, usually ~200ms. Attached logs link: https://internal.logs/redwood/rc-20260210-9a7b (internal).

support-bot: Created INC-2026-1023 and routed to eng-ml. Assigned: jordan_ml.

jordan_ml: Quick mitigation: advise customer to set "json_mode": "lenient" or add a post-processing coercion step (coerce_number=true). Also we can harden the output by adding a clarifying system instruction in the request: 

```
System: Return all numeric ids as unquoted JSON numbers. Do not quote booleans. Follow the provided JSON schema strictly.
```

That often fixes generation variance. For long-term fix we should add an explicit type-enforcing sampling bias on the runtime or run a small output-canonicalizer before returning to strict mode.

mike_support: Can you confirm if adding the system line + small temperature drop (t=0.0) stabilizes it? If yes, we can share as an interim workaround and escalate engineering for a runtime-level coercion toggle.

elena: Will test with customer and report back. For now telling them to try lenient + system instruction. Escalating to eng-ml for a durable fix. :thumbsup:

mike_support: Thanks — please paste results here when you have them and attach a failing sample for the eng ticket so we can reproduce offline.
